name: The Boathouse
hint: Fix the lamp. Tap things to look; tap an item, then a thing, to use it.

hotspots.name: Old net
hotspots.look: Something glints in the old net: a small brass key!

text: The key turns with a gritty click.
Inside: a fresh spool of wick, and a pair of shears with lamp oil still on the blades.

*.text: It's padlocked. You need a key.

hotspots.name: Open toolbox
hotspots.look: Empty now, except for those oily shears.

hotspots.name: Oil drum
hotspots.look: Half a drum of lamp oil. You fill a flask.

hotspots.name: Boot prints
hotspots.look: Wet boot prints, big ones, leading from the slipway to the toolbox. Still damp.
